params.message:
A finished Blurit task whose image is gone is sent again, and the sweep releases an own photo

Blurit keeps a finished image only for a while. On 2026-11-25 the first sweeps of
stocklist:blur-pending found eleven tasks Blurit still called Succeeded whose image it answered
with HTTP 400 "File ... not found". The sweep counted that as unreachable and asked again every
ten minutes for good. BluritService::media() now returns null on a client error, and such a
copy goes the way of a failed task: sent again, removed after three tasks. An own photo is not
blurred (R S1-6.5), so the sweep releases it without asking Blurit.

Refs #1122
